data.action: 伫立于高空平台边缘俯瞰下方红色海洋
data.camera: wide shot, Rei in the foreground at the platform rail and the distant cruciform figure across the lake
data.description: 深邃浩瀚的地底最终教条区，庞大无垠的LCL红海散发着神圣而压抑的光晕。绫波丽身着白色的战斗服独立于钢铁升降梯前端，凝视着沉眠于十字架上的神之具现，眼底涌动着超越人类理解的崇高宿命——「这就是最初与最终的源头……一切生命归于一体的时刻，终将到来。」
data.lighting: 最终教条区LCL赤海微光与高穹神圣探照光束
data.location: NERV 最终教条区 LCL 巨大湖泊
data.promptProse: Across a vast red lake, the colossal body of Lilith hangs from the distant white cross. Its outstretched wrists are fastened to the ends of the crossbeam. Its smooth chalk-white body dwarfs the cavern pillars and a dark seven-eyed mask covers its face. On the foreground steel platform stands Rei, the only pilot, her short blue hair and plain fitted white plugsuit visible from behind as she looks toward the cross.
data.title: 绫波丽 · 最终教条的神圣肃穆
